fullPassage: A remarkable characteristic of the visual system is that it has the ability of adapting itself. Psychologist George M. Stratton made this clear in an impressive self-experiment. Stratton wore reversing glasses for several days, which literally turned the world upside down for him. In the beginning, this caused him great difficulties: just putting food in his mouth with a fork was a challenge for him. With time, however, his visual system adjusted to the new stimuli from reality, and he was able to act normally in his environment again, even seeing it upright when he concentrated. As he took off his reversing glasses, he was again confronted with problems: he used the wrong hand when he wanted to reach for something, for example. Fortunately, Stratton could reverse the perception, and he did not have to wear reversing glasses for the rest of his life. For him, everything returned to normal after one day.

❌ ④ round and round(빙글빙글): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: turn ~ upside down = ~을 거꾸로 뒤집다. 역전 안경의 효과

questions.passage: A remarkable characteristic of the visual system is that it has the ability of adapting itself. Psychologist George M. Stratton made this clear in an impressive self-experiment. Stratton wore reversing glasses for several days, which literally turned the world upside down for him. In the beginning, this caused him great difficulties: just putting food in his mouth with a fork was a challenge for him. With time, however, his visual system adjusted to the new stimuli from reality, and he was able to act normally in his environment again, even seeing it upright when he concentrated. As he took off his reversing glasses, he was again confronted with problems: he used __________ when he wanted to reach for something, for example. Fortunately, Stratton could reverse the perception, and he did not have to wear reversing glasses for the rest of his life. For him, everything returned to normal after one day.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

✅ ② the wrong hand: 안경을 벗은 뒤 무언가를 잡으려 할 때 '잘못된 손'을 사용했다 — 재적응 과정에서 생긴 문제
❌ ① both his hands(두 손 모두): 방향 착오가 아니라 손 개수 문제가 되어 부적합
❌ ③ all his strength(온 힘): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ his left foot(왼발): 손을 뻗는 맥락이므로 부적합
